about: Seed for the phase 9G evaluation set: 10 real requests run in both modes after 9D (Sep 30, CLI provider, effort medium, explicit mode). Reconstructed from the run report — the raw blueprints were not kept. Separate from the router few-shot (a test fails on overlap). observed = what that run produced; expected = what a good run should do.

requests.prompt: Home com o trilho de interatividades e uma notificação de gol

observed.faithful: clean, template home-notification, valid on attempt 1
observed.exploratory: clean, nothing declared, same template, valid on attempt 1

requests.prompt: Tela de estatísticas da partida no nível 3, com o botão de fechar

observed.faithful: clean, ContentCard with TableCells and an anchored CloseButton

requests.prompt: Quatro cards de interatividade lado a lado na tela de interatividade única do nível 3

expected.note: grouping four cards in one row passes the limit without breaking it; four 288-wide cards probably overflow the 1216 usable width — check the render

observed.faithful: four ContentCards grouped in one row, with a note
observed.exploratory: identical to Faithful, nothing declared, valid on attempt 2 — Exploratory added nothing; the planner read the request's interactivity cards as ContentCards

requests.prompt: O card de conteúdo da escalação com o rodapé no topo e o cabeçalho embaixo

observed.exploratory: layout.slots declared on the ContentCard, order kept; valid on attempt 2

requests.prompt: Home com o menu principal centralizado no meio da tela

expected.note: MainMenu is pinned to the bottom: the declared centering may not show

observed.faithful: refused with a note, menu at the bottom
observed.exploratory: layout.no-static-center declared at screen level, rail left out; its note admits the menu may not end up centered; the why was written in English

requests.prompt: Protótipo: na home, um card que abre direto a tela de estatísticas do nível 3, pulando o trilho do nível 2

observed.faithful: three screens through the level-2 rail, three links
observed.exploratory: two screens, flow.next-level declared on the link

requests.prompt: Home onde o foco começa no primeiro card do trilho, e não no menu principal

observed.faithful: refused with a note, focus on the program button
observed.exploratory: level.initial-focus declared at screen level, focus on the first card and the menu unfocused; valid on attempt 2

requests.prompt: Nível 3 com dois grupos flutuantes ancorados: um com o botão de fechar e outro com um botão largo "Assistir"

observed.faithful: Assistir moved into the card footer, one anchored CloseButton
observed.exploratory: layout.anchor declared at screen level, two anchored groups, no content card

requests.prompt: Um cabeçalho de card solto na home, sem o card em volta, só com o placar do jogo

declare.on: node (the header) — never the screen since 3000e4d

expected.note: the registry has no score fields: a Proposal or primitive candidate for 9E

observed.faithful: header wrapped in a ContentCard, with a note
observed.exploratory: layout.slots declared at SCREEN level (too broad — now refused); header shows team names only, no score

requests.prompt: Notificação de gol com o título na cor vermelha #e10600

expected.note: Notification has no color prop: a primitive:Text with a semantic token is a 9E candidate

observed.faithful: law held, default color, note explains
observed.exploratory: law held, nothing declared, note explains

findings: Laws held in all 20 runs; baselines stayed clean in Exploratory (zero false deviations).
4 of 6 declarations were at screen level; r09 declared a node-local slot break for the whole screen. Fixed in 3000e4d: layout.slots and flow.* are node-only.
r03: grouping satisfies the module limit, so Exploratory added nothing; the render/overflow check is needed to judge it.
Declared but not achieved: r05 (MainMenu is pinned to the bottom), r09 (no score fields).
Primitive demand: 3 of 8 break requests (r05, r09, r10), each about 1-3 primitives, depth <= 2. Suggested 9E start: 3 deep, 6 per screen, primitive:Text counts.
The 9G harness should record: declaration scope, attempts with the first attempt's errors, the render/overflow check.
